########################################
#
# Script contains analyses to determine a filter strategy for 
# downstream spAIRR analysis:
# 'Base': all reads, 'F1': consensus count > 1, 'F2': consenus count > 2
# 'F3': consensus count > 3.
#
# Analyses are performed on representable datasets from Visium HD 3' (S4_ONT_Q17_HD)
#
# Analysis include heavy-light chain UMI count per SPBC correlation across filter strategies.
# Spatial distribution showing number of distinct UMIs per spatial spot across filter strategies.
# Spatial distribution of representable light chain clone across filter strategies
# Correlation of number of UMIs per SPBC and total number of reads per SPBC across filter strategies
#
# Results are shown in LongAIRR Fig. 5 and S4
#
########################################

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
save_dir <- file.path("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel5/intermediates/")
```


# Read data
```{r}
nano_1_bcr <- read.csv("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision/af5_samples/sp21_hd_sd17_af5/post_whitelist_run/airr/tmp/ig/ig_db-pass.tsv", sep = "\t") 

nano_1_tcr <- read.csv("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision/af5_samples/sp21_hd_sd17_af5/post_whitelist_run/airr/tmp/tr/tr_db-pass.tsv", sep = "\t")
```

```{r}
nano_df <- rbind(rbind(nano_1_bcr %>% mutate(type = "BCR"), 
                       nano_1_tcr %>% mutate(type = "TCR")) %>% 
                   mutate(data = "S4_ONT_Q17_HD")) %>%
                   mutate(v_region_sequence = stringr::str_sub(toupper(sequence),
                                      start = as.integer(v_sequence_start), end = as.integer(v_sequence_end))) %>%
                               filter(!is.na(c_call) & str_sub(c_call, 1, 3) == locus & !grepl("TTTTTTTTTTT", umi) & !grepl("N", junction)) %>%
                               filter(!grepl("N", v_region_sequence))
```

# Baseline
## correlation of chain expression

```{r}
chain_correlation <- function(df, tcr_or_bcr) {
  # if bcr combine K+L
  if(tcr_or_bcr == "BCR") {
    res <- df %>%
      dplyr::filter(type == "BCR") %>%
      dplyr::select(spbcid, n_keep, data, locus, umi) %>%
      group_by(spbcid, data, locus) %>%
      summarize(cnt_umi_spbc = n_distinct(umi)) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = locus, values_from = cnt_umi_spbc, values_fill = 0) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(light = IGK + IGL)
  }
  else if(tcr_or_bcr == "TCR") {
    res <- df %>%
      dplyr::filter(type == "TCR") %>%
      dplyr::select(spbcid, n_keep, data, locus, umi) %>%
      group_by(spbcid, data, locus) %>%
      summarize(cnt_umi_spbc = n_distinct(umi)) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = locus, values_from = cnt_umi_spbc, values_fill = 0)
  }
  res
}
```


Initial data wrangling for all filter approaches

# Base
```{r}
#correlation
base_bcr_cor_df <- chain_correlation(nano_df, "BCR") %>% dplyr::mutate(filt = "base")
base_tcr_cor_df <- chain_correlation(nano_df, "TCR") %>% dplyr::mutate(filt = "base")
```

```{r}
base_clone_df <- nano_df %>%
  mutate(clone_id = paste(v_call, j_call, junction, sep = "_")) %>%
  group_by(clone_id, locus, data) %>%
  summarize(n_umi_in_clone = n(), n_spbc_in_clone = n_distinct(spbcid)) %>% dplyr::mutate(filt = "base")
```

```{r}
base_spbc_df <- nano_df %>%
  group_by(spbcid, locus, data, x, y) %>%
  summarize(nb_seqs = sum(consensus_count), nb_umis = n_distinct(umi))  %>% 
  mutate(filt = "base")
```

example
```{r}
nano_df %>%
  group_by(locus, data) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), n_spbc = n_distinct(spbcid)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(data == "S4_ONT_Q17_HD")
```


# Correlation summary
--------------
S4c
--------------

```{r, fig.width=3.2, fig.height=1.5}
corr_igexp_plt <- rbind(base_bcr_cor_df, f1_bcr_cor_df, f2_bcr_cor_df, f3_bcr_cor_df) %>%
  filter(data == "S4_ONT_Q17_HD") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = IGH, y = light)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(linewidth = 0.35) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~filt, ncol = 4) +
  xlab("Heavy chain (IGH)\nUMI count per SPBC (log10)") +
  ylab("Light chain (IGK + IGL)\nUMI count per SPBC\n(log10)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 2)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 2)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray92", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
```

```{r, fig.width=2.5, fig.height=1.5}
ps4_c <- corr_igexp_plt + patchwork::plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.margin = margin(l=5, 5, 5, 5)))
ps4_c
```

```{r}
#save_plot("figures/corr_igexp_HD.pdf", corr_igexp_plt, base_width = 6.5, base_height = 2.9)
save_dir_supp <- file.path("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp4/intermediates/")
saveRDS(ps4_c, file=file.path(save_dir_supp, "ps4_c.rds"))
```


# Spatial coordinates
--------------
S4d
--------------

```{r}
umi_dist_plt <- rbind(base_spbc_df, f1_spbc_df, f2_spbc_df, f3_spbc_df) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  filter(data == "S4_ONT_Q17_HD") %>%
  filter(locus %in% c("IGH", "IGK", "IGL")) %>%
  mutate(nb_umis_bin = case_when(
      nb_umis <= 1  ~ "1",
      nb_umis <= 2  ~ "2",
      nb_umis <= 3  ~ "3",
      nb_umis <= 4  ~ "4",
      nb_umis < 10  ~ "5-9",
      nb_umis >= 10 ~ "≥10"),
    nb_umis_bin = factor(nb_umis_bin, levels = c("≥10", "5-9", "4", "3", "2", "1"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = y, y = -x, color = nb_umis_bin)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.25, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(locus ~ filt) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "1"   = "gray80",
      "2"   = "#2f5e8f",
      "3"   = "#1b9e77",
      "4"   = "#bf8630",
      "5-9" = "#d95f02",
      "≥10" = "red3"),
    drop = FALSE, name = "  Number of\nDistinct UMIs") +
  labs(x = "x-coordinate", y = "y-coordinate") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    #panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    #panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 2)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 2)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(l=-4),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray92", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1)))
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=3}
ps4_d <- umi_dist_plt + patchwork::plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.margin = margin(l=5, 5, 5, 5)))
ps4_d
```

```{r}

saveRDS(ps4_d, file=file.path(save_dir_supp, "ps4_d.rds"))
```


# Look at clone recovery
--------------
S4e
--------------

Representative IGL clone spatial distribution

```{r}
clone_pick_df2 <- rbind(
  nano_df %>%
    mutate(clone_id = paste(v_call, j_call, junction, sep = "_")) %>%
    group_by(clone_id, spbcid) %>%
    mutate(n_seqs_in_clone_spbc = n()) %>%
    mutate(filt = "base"),

  nano_df_f1 %>%
    mutate(clone_id = paste(v_call, j_call, junction, sep = "_")) %>%
    group_by(clone_id, spbcid) %>%
    mutate(n_seqs_in_clone_spbc = n()) %>%
    mutate(filt = "F1"),

  nano_df_f2 %>%
    mutate(clone_id = paste(v_call, j_call, junction, sep = "_")) %>%
    group_by(clone_id, spbcid) %>%
    mutate(n_seqs_in_clone_spbc = n()) %>%
    mutate(filt = "F2"),

  nano_df_f3 %>%
    mutate(clone_id = paste(v_call, j_call, junction, sep = "_")) %>%
    group_by(clone_id, spbcid) %>%
    mutate(n_seqs_in_clone_spbc = n()) %>%
    mutate(filt = "F3")) %>%
  filter(v_call == "IGLV2-14*01,IGLV2-14*03",
    j_call == "IGLJ3*02",
    junction == "TGCGGCTCATATACAAGCAGCACCACTCTGGTGTTC") %>%
  group_by(filt, spbcid, x, y, data) %>%
  summarise(n_umi = n_distinct(umi),
    sum_reads = sum(n_keep),
    .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
clone_subtitle <- paste(
  "IGLV2-14*01,IGLV2-14*03 | IGLJ3*02 |",
  "TGCGGCTCATATACAAGCAGCACCACTCTGGTGTTC")


l_clone_ex <- clone_pick_df2 %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(n_umi_bin = case_when(
      n_umi <= 1  ~ "1",
      n_umi <= 2  ~ "2",
      n_umi <= 3  ~ "3",
      n_umi <= 4  ~ "4",
      n_umi < 10  ~ "5-9",
      n_umi >= 10 ~ "≥10"),
    n_umi_bin = factor(n_umi_bin, levels = c("≥10", "5-9", "4", "3", "2", "1"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = y, y = -x, color = n_umi_bin)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(data ~ filt,
  labeller = labeller(data = c("S4_ONT_Q17_HD" = "S4_ONT_Q17_HD\nVisium HD 3'"))) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "1"   = "gray80",
      "2"   = "#2f5e8f",
      "3"   = "#1b9e77",
      "4"   = "#bf8630",
      "5-9" = "#d95f02",
      "≥10" = "red3"),
    drop = FALSE, name = "Number of\n   UMIs") +
  labs(x = "x-coordinate", y = "y-coordinate", subtitle = paste("Clonotype:", clone_subtitle)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    #panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    #panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 2)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 2)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(t=-4),
    legend.margin = margin(t=-4),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray92", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 5, color = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1), nrow=1))
```
